description: Operator-facing glue: a mock-mode smoke script over all 7 endpoints, a committed .env.example (key names + placeholders + per-key UI-location comments), a .gitignore that excludes .env, and README-sources.md documenting the endpoints, sam validate/deploy (incl. preprod params), the SOURCE_MODE flip, env vars, API-key passing, and the sandbox-not-a-TLSNotary-target note. Depends on FEAT-003 (imports the adapter).
steps: Create c:\Users\AnudeepSaiNunna\workspace\Kiro\logging\dowsure-oracle\.worktrees\source-mocks\scripts\source-smoke.py: reads SOURCE_MODE, imports coordinator.sources, calls all 7 endpoints, prints for each: label, HTTP status, and a short body summary (e.g. top-level keys + count). Mock mode must run end-to-end with no creds. Include a safe-by-default guard: if SOURCE_MODE=sandbox and required creds are absent, print a clear message and skip the live call rather than crashing. Agents run it ONLY in mock mode.

Create committed c:\Users\AnudeepSaiNunna\workspace\Kiro\logging\dowsure-oracle\.worktrees\source-mocks\.env.example with KEY NAMES only, empty/placeholder values, and a per-key comment on where to obtain it in the provider UI. Keys: SOURCE_MODE (mock|sandbox); MOCK_API_KEY (API Gateway > API Keys > the deployed key, via `aws apigateway get-api-key --api-key <id> --include-value`); AMAZON_SP_BASE_URL; LWA_CLIENT_ID / LWA_CLIENT_SECRET / LWA_REFRESH_TOKEN (Amazon SP-API developer console > your app > LWA credentials; refresh token from the authorize flow); AWS_REGION; ALICLOUD_BASE_URL; ALICLOUD_APPCODE (Aliyun console > API Market > your subscription > AppCode); QICHACHA_BASE_URL; QICHACHA_APP_KEY / QICHACHA_SECRET_KEY (Qichacha open-platform console > my data > key management); GUTU_BASE_URL; GUTU_TOKEN (Gutu/Valuemap tenant console > API access token). Do NOT create a real .env with values.

Create c:\Users\AnudeepSaiNunna\workspace\Kiro\logging\dowsure-oracle\.worktrees\source-mocks\.gitignore (none exists yet) containing at least `.env` (and `.aws-sam/`, `__pycache__/`, `*.pyc`). If a .gitignore is later found, append rather than overwrite.

Create c:\Users\AnudeepSaiNunna\workspace\Kiro\logging\dowsure-oracle\.worktrees\source-mocks\sam\mocks\README-sources.md (do NOT touch sam/README.md). Document: (1) the 7 endpoints table (provider, method, path, operation); (2) how to `sam validate --lint` and `sam deploy` BOTH new stacks to PREPROD - exact commands: `sam deploy --template-file sam\mocks\amazon-sp\template.yaml --stack-name amazon-sp-contract-mock --profile preprod --region ap-southeast-1 --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM --resolve-s3` and the kyc equivalent (account 706179786846, Singapore ap-southeast-1, proxy OFF in office); (3) how SOURCE_MODE flips mock<->sandbox and that mock mode needs no creds; (4) the full env var list with where-to-get-it; (5) how the caller passes the API key (x-api-key header; retrieve the value with `aws apigateway get-api-key --api-key <ApiKeyId-output> --include-value --profile preprod --region ap-southeast-1`); (6) a clear note: the Amazon sandbox returns canned fixtures, so it is NOT a valid TLSNotary target - TLSNotary proves provenance of REAL production data; a proof over a sandbox session attests only to fixture data and is meaningless. TLSNotary remains the real-production-only gate.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/source-smoke.py runs in SOURCE_MODE=mock against a local stub and prints 7 status lines with no creds.
.env.example is committed with key names + placeholders + per-key UI-source comments and NO real values.
sam/mocks/README-sources.md covers the 7 endpoints, preprod sam deploy commands, SOURCE_MODE, env list, api-key passing, and the sandbox-not-a-TLSNotary note; sam/README.md is unchanged.
verification: `python -m unittest tests.test_sources` still passes. Then start a tiny local stub (e.g. `python -m http.server` serving fixed JSON, or point the adapter at a file:// / localhost stub inside the smoke script's self-test path) and run `python scripts\source-smoke.py` with SOURCE_MODE=mock; confirm 7 lines print and exit code 0.

`git -C c:\Users\AnudeepSaiNunna\workspace\Kiro\logging\dowsure-oracle\.worktrees\source-mocks status --porcelain` shows .env.example and .gitignore staged/untracked but NO .env; `Select-String -Path .env.example -Pattern 'amzn1','Atzr|','=.+[A-Za-z0-9]{20}'` returns no real-looking secret values.
findings:
